name: Kids Quad Biking
blurb: A fenced, flat area away from the main dunes so younger riders get their own space.

durations.label: 30 minutes
durations.blurb: The lowest commitment. Enough to learn the controls and cross a few dune faces on the Kids Quad.

durations.label: 1 hour
durations.blurb: The sweet spot for most riders. Time to settle into the Kids Quad and get a proper run at the red dunes.

durations.label: 2 hours
durations.blurb: A longer route with more varied terrain and photo stops, for riders already comfortable on the Kids Quad.

durations.label: 3 hours
durations.blurb: A half-day session. Suits confident riders and groups pairing the ride with a camp stop.

durations.label: 4 hours
durations.blurb: The longest route we run on the Kids Quad. For experienced riders who want maximum time in the dunes.
